title: Farmer Bridge Assistance (FBA) Program; Correction
summary: Agriculture Department, Commodity Credit Corporation — Rule — The Commodity Credit Corporation (CCC) announced the Farmer Bridge Assistance (FBA) Program in a final rule on February 23, 2026. This correction amends the definition of "corn" to add blue and red corn, which are eligible commodities for the FBA Program.
